question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT im.interest_id, im.month_year, im.composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY im.interest_id 
        ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year ASC
    ) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.month_year,
        im2.interest_name,
        mc.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition DESC) as rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM max_composition mc
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON mc.interest_id = im2.id
)
SELECT month_year, interest_name, composition
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_desc <= 10 OR rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY composition DESC
